opportunity.title: Marine Corps Education Command Information Technology Support Services
opportunity.description: Marine Corps Installations Command National Capital Region Regional Contracting Office, Quantico VA, requires IT support services for the USMC Education Command. Single-award IDIQ with firm fixed-price line items for services and cost-reimbursement for travel, five-year ordering period, $45M ceiling. 100% set aside for Women-Owned Small Business under FAR 19.15. Commercial contracting under FAR Part 12 and FAR 15 negotiation, best value trade-off, all-or-none award. Solicitation M00264-27-R-0001 is posted in PIEE. Work is mainly at Marine Corps University, Quantico VA and regional campuses across multiple sites.

rationale.point: The opportunity is a 100% WOSB set-aside IDIQ, and Magnolia holds WOSB and EDWOSB certifications, satisfying the set-aside eligibility.

The requirement for comprehensive IT support to sustain the professional military education mission aligns directly with Magnolia's strongest past performance in training and education data systems, including a Marine Corps training-data contract.
The contracting office location in Quantico, VA is within Magnolia's declared places of performance (VA, REMOTE), supporting geographic eligibility.

risks: Magnolia has only 11 staff and no facility clearance, which may limit ability to execute a $45M ceiling IDIQ or meet on-site requirements.
Past performance maximum is ~$1.5M (Marine Corps) and two civilian task orders under $800K, a significant gap to the IDIQ ceiling.
Rapid scaling and compliance with DoD IT support standards may require teaming or subcontracting.
nextSteps: Identify teaming partners with facility clearance and larger DoD IT support capacity to strengthen proposal.
Clarify with the contracting office whether facility clearance is mandatory or if remote performance is acceptable for all task orders.
Develop past performance narratives emphasizing the Marine Corps training-data contract and analytics task orders as relevant to EDCOM's education mission.
Model staffing plans for potential task order sizes to demonstrate credible capacity.
